name: popsicle
headline: Mailchamp: Email Marketing UI Clone
short_description: Mailchamp is a front-end web project that clones core UI pages of a marketing email platform, including landing, login, pricing, and payment pages.
author: rajeshdeo

sections.overview:
Mailchamp is an open-source frontend project built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript that replicates the user interface of an email marketing platform. The repository includes multiple pages such as a landing page, login page, pricing page, and payment page, along with modular navbar components and associated stylesheets. It is structured with separate components, scripts, and styles directories, reflecting a multi-page web application layout. This project is useful for developers learning to build and structure marketing-style web interfaces or looking to reference a multi-page HTML/CSS/JS project.
Reference implementation for building multi-page marketing website UIs
Learning project for HTML, CSS, and JavaScript page structure
Starting template for a login and payment page flow
Study example for modular navbar component design
- **Subject Line**: Unlock 30% Savings on Solar Panels This Week Only!
- **Target Audience**: Homeowners in California aged 30-55
- **Send Time**: Tuesday at 10 AM PST
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/rajeshdeo/mailchamp`
sections.usage:
```
Act as an expert in email marketing using Mailchamp. Help me create a campaign for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] business. Use [DATA] to craft a compelling subject line, email body, and call-to-action. Include segmentation strategies and A/B testing recommendations.
```
